segments.text: Come closer
This story starts with a window and a fight for the view back when the web was young
two Giants fought to frame the view
Netscape faced Explorer for the window we looked through
Netscape opened up its code let more hands inside the frame
Mozilla kept the work alive then Firefox stepped into the game
Add a button block the track and make the browser fit your day
Look beneath the painted surface change the way the pieces play more eyes checking all the wire and more hands working at the seams
The doorway had a handle on our side of the screen
Who owns your doorway who decides what you can see?
Let me look let me change it leave the fine
Oh say with me the app see a friend I know
Find a little shop watch a garden grow
Every time I pause every clip I say gives the feet a clue shapes the next display
I can use a voice I can choose the friend
But the app still sorts what it wants to send I can choose who I follow can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look leave the final say with me
Make a workshop page. Here's the time and place use the notes
I gave leave some breathing space show me what you wrote that sounds like a sale
Tell them what they'll learn give the plain details check the date again make the link work right wait until I say then put the
page online
Save a note for me clear words skip the pitch read it next time round
Let me edit it the model works with words an app connects the tools we call that app a harness
We get to choose its rules. Let me see its notes
Let me set its reach if I change the model keep the work with me my words build the harness
I call my own from every seed of thought I've sown let me look
Leave the final say with me. Let me look let me change it leave the fine
Say with me
Toaster I buy the power. I choose the model. I choose the rules same old question a new machine
Leave the fire
